definition.description: REV | Acceptance | Reminders & Escalation (wbs:3.3, DEV only per EX-006/EX-007). Reminders are set by wbs:3.2 at send time (IMP-0618); this flow is escalation ONLY - process-owner alert past Setting.EscalationDays (FR-044). See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. The escalation recipient, injected per environment at import (C-TECH-047).
Environment variable. Base URL of REV Grant Administration for this environment, for the card's deep link to the grant. Empty is handled: the button link degrades to plain text.

Every_morning.description: 06:00 UTC, every day including weekends - unlike the Daily Summary's weekday-only schedule, elapsed days toward the 14-day threshold keep counting over a weekend, so escalation cannot skip a check.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Holds the failed action name and reason for the alert. Top level, same pattern as every other flow in this solution. See notes.md.

Escalate_overdue_acceptances.description: One scope so one failure branch catches everything below it, same shape as every other flow in this solution.

Read_escalation_threshold.description: A-DS-6: reads Setting.EscalationDays (FR-044). Read via ListRecords with a $filter, the house pattern for this connector (IMP-0112/IMP-0116) - never Get-a-row-by-id, even keyed by rev_name.

Compose_escalation_threshold_days.description: A-DS-6: falls back to 14 - the TAD's OWN literal (5.9/FR-044), not an invented number - if the row is ever absent, rather than failing every run over an unseeded setting.

Compose_escalation_cutoff.description: A grant issued on or before this instant has now sat unsigned for at least the configured threshold.

List_overdue_grants.description: rev_status eq 2 (not yet Signed) is the sole eligibility signal - deliberately NOT a DocuSign query, avoiding a second unverified wire-shape guess. rev_escalatedon eq null is the idempotency guard (FR-044). See notes.md.

parameters.$filter: @{concat('rev_status eq 2 and rev_acceptanceissuedon le ', outputs('Compose_escalation_cutoff'), ' and rev_escalatedon eq null')}

Escalate_each_overdue_grant.description: Each iteration reads its own records and writes its own grant row - no shared-variable mutation across iterations, unlike the Scoring flow's point-accumulation loop, so concurrency is not pinned to 1.

Get_the_application.description: Reads the applicant lookup and referee name for the escalation card (FR-044: 'with the applicant's details').

Get_the_applicant.description: Reads the applicant's name for the card. Tier 4, released to REV Admins/REV Service Accounts by REV_TrusteeRestricted.

Compose_days_overdue.description: Whole days since rev_acceptanceissuedon, via ticks() - the workflow definition language has no direct date-diff function (E1/E2: standard, documented WDL, not DocuSign-specific). 864000000000 ticks per day.

Notify_escalation_card.description: FR-044: escalation WITH the applicant's details, a deliberate departure from the Scoring flow's Borderline card (which withholds the name by design) - FR-044's own wording requires it. 1:1 chat only (ADR-015), same as every Teams post in this solution.

parameters.body/messageBody: {"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Acceptance overdue","wrap":true,"weight":"Bolder","size":"Medium","color":"Attention"},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Unsigned past the escalation threshold - needs your attention.","wrap":true,"isSubtle":true,"spacing":"None"},{"type":"FactSet","spacing":"Medium","separator":true,"facts":[{"title":"Grant reference","value":"@{item()?['rev_name']}"},{"title":"Applicant","value":"@{coalesce(first(body('Get_the_applicant')?['value'])?['rev_fullname'], 'not on file')}"},{"title":"Referee","value":"@{coalesce(first(body('Get_the_application')?['value'])?['rev_refereename'], 'not on file')}"},{"title":"Days unsigned","value":"@{string(outputs('Compose_days_overdue'))}"},{"title":"DocuSign envelope","value":"@{coalesce(item()?['rev_docusignenvelopeid'], 'none')}"}]},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"Follow up directly with the applicant and/or referee, or void and reissue the envelope if it has lapsed.","wrap":true,"spacing":"Medium","separator":true},{"type":"TextBlock","text":"This message carries the applicant's name and the referee's name by design (FR-044) - unlike this solution's other Teams alerts, which withhold names.","wrap":true,"isSubtle":true,"size":"Small","spacing":"Medium"}],"actions":[{"type":"Action.OpenUrl","title":"Open this grant","url":"@{parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl')}"}]}

Notify_escalation.description: Fallback for the card above, same content as plain HTML with a link instead of a button, so a rejected card payload still reaches the process owner - same shape as REV | Ops | Failure Alert's own fallback.

parameters.body/messageBody:
Acceptance overdue

Grant reference: @{item()?['rev_name']}
Applicant: @{coalesce(first(body('Get_the_applicant')?['value'])?['rev_fullname'], 'not on file')}
Referee: @{coalesce(first(body('Get_the_application')?['value'])?['rev_refereename'], 'not on file')}
Days unsigned: @{string(outputs('Compose_days_overdue'))}
DocuSign envelope: @{coalesce(item()?['rev_docusignenvelopeid'], 'none')}

Follow up directly, or void and reissue the envelope if it has lapsed.

@{if(empty(coalesce(parameters('rev_GrantAdminAppUrl'), '')), '', concat('

Open this grant

'))}

Stamp_escalated.description: FR-044 idempotency guard: stamps rev_escalatedon so tomorrow's run does not re-notify this grant. Only stamped once a notification actually reached the process owner by one of the two routes.

Find_the_failed_action.description: Same pattern as every other flow in this solution: the child of the failed scope whose own status is Failed, not the scope's generic wrapper message.

Set_failure_detail.description: No nested Scope/If container inside Escalate_overdue_acceptances needs descending into - only a Foreach, which this solution's precedent (REV | Scoring | Calculate & Flag) also treats as the leaf rather than unwrapping further.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Compose_run_link.description: Deep link to THIS run, built here because workflow() inside the child returns the child's own identity, not the caller's.

Alert_on_failure.description: FR-010. No single grant reference identifies this run (it processes a batch), so text_3 names the flow's own batch nature rather than one grant.

body.text_3: batch run - see run link for which grant(s) were affected
